description: Digital banner artwork on a parchment-style background depicting a golden-armored warrior in the 'Armor of God' motif from Ephesians 6 — his helmet is labeled SALVATION, breastplate RIGHTEOUSNESS, belt SPIRIT/TRUTH, shield FAITH, and greave GOSPEL. Beside the figure, the title THE SHIELD OF FAITH appears with the Bible verse Ephesians 6:16 quoted. Filename: Shield_of_Faith.jpg.
text: THE SHIELD OF FAITH. 'In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.'. SALVATION. RIGHTEOUSNESS. SPIRIT. TRUTH. FAITH. GOSPEL.

description: Video frame of a Fox News Channel on-air graphic titled COVID SURVIVAL RATE, listing survival percentages by age group and attributing the figures to the CDC: 0-19 years 99.997%, 20-49 years 99.98%, 50-69 years 99.5%, 70+ years 94.6%. The Fox News logo appears lower left and a news ticker about a suspected Novichok poisoning runs along the bottom. Filename: C19SurvRate.jpg.
text: COVID SURVIVAL RATE. 0-19 YEARS 99.997%. 20-49 YEARS 99.98%. 50-69 YEARS 99.5%. 70+ YEARS 94.6%. CDC. FOX NEWS channel. EATMENT FOR SUSPECTED NOVICHOK POISONING...KREMLIN DENIES INVOLVEMENT. FOX NEWS. NYC'S.
flags: Survival-rate figures are the broadcast graphic's claim attributed to CDC scenario estimates; carried as shown, not verified

description: Screenshot of a purported group-chat log titled 'Palpatine's Revenge', with pseudonymous participants (Dooku, Severus, Huck, Roger, Juules) shown with identical green diamond avatars, timestamped May 17. The messages depict the participants coordinating media leaks and memos, referencing initials such as RR, MF, S, AE/AEWP and RM, a 'limey', 'Camp Eagle', and an asset en route. The chat circulated online as an alleged leaked conversation among government officials plotting leaks; its provenance and authenticity are unverified. Filename: blackmail.jpg.
text: Palpatine's Revenge. Dooku joined the group. Dooku May 17 at 2:31 pm RR isn't taking shit.. and he knows our friends have stuff on him. Dooku May 17 at 2:32 pm I'm hearing Mueller, maybe by the end of the week. Severus May 17 at 2:37 pm Hearing that too.. WH will be blind-sided. Let's put MF back in the news? Can have S draw up memo on Turkey. With Erdogan thugs beating protesters in streets, it fits news cycle, and I'm sure we'll need a few more "memos" down the road. Good practice. Huck May 17 at 2:41 pm I'm in. S, you in here? Our friends in NY still have secure connection set up waiting. Roger May 17 at 2:42 pm MF was mentioned in company group too... Evidently their work on the limey is paying off. Dooku May 17 at 2:43 pm Paying off how?. Dooku May 17 at 2:43 pm Getting to him?. Roger May 17 at 2:45 pm Yea.. he mentioned Limey in a call earlier this week. Scared shitless. Severus May 17 at 2:45 pm He isn't brightest bulb, but that project has worked perfectly. Roger May 17 at 2:47 pm It really has. Huck, didn't AEWP mention it when we gave him that tape?. Huck May 17 at 2:47 pm Not AE, but someone else there. Not sure who. I wasn't listening in, but our carrier pigeon said in debrief that they said something along lines of: "No wonder no one in our business has called Limey out, what's the point when you all keep bringing us great stuff? It actually helps our pageviews when she gets all of her minions fired up with dumb shit first". Severus May 17 at 2:53 pm That's fuckin amazing. Juules May 17 at 3:01 pm Hey all, been watching in. Here with S in GT outpost. All go from us. Huck, will send memo to usual place. Do your magic. Juules May 17 at 3:03 pm Roger, any update on Camp Eagle?. Roger May 17 at 3:06 pm Asset en route. Don't expect much from it. He's been out far too long. Juules May 17 at 3:07 pm Figures. Ok, Huck, keep that connection open and expect something to come through pipeline a little later. Just stall them. RM is happening tonight, so they'll have plenty to cover. Dooku May 17 at 3:08 pm Tonight. Fuck. Quicker than I thought. Huck May 17 at 3:10 pm Connection will remain open. Let me know if we want to tip on RM. Juules May 17 at 3:12 pm Just let it ride. Juules May 17 at 3:15 pm Today's time is up. Everyone knows what to do. Tomorrow will be busy day for all, so will let everyone know time when S hears from grapevine.
flags: Provenance and authenticity of the chat log are unverified; it circulated as an alleged leaked conversation among officials
Participants use pseudonyms; no individuals are identifiable
Initials in the chat (RR, MF, S, RM) invite identification of real officials but the image itself names no one beyond 'Mueller' and 'Erdogan'

description: Screenshot of Q drop #4828, posted Oct 7 2020 by tripcode Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 (ID 3dc07c, No. 10974299). The drop's claims are the poster's assertions. Filename: OCT_NK_L.jpg.

Do you remember when Hawaii 'accidentally' sounded the incoming missile alarm?. What happened?. NK no longer a nuclear threat?. Mountain collapse?. China seeking NK commitment to fire short[long]-range ballistic missile(s) pre_election?. Q
